lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two of them on the valley road ahead. One machine, one man. Neither is hurrying, because there is nowhere on this road that is not also the road.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Flagged file, dead card, and an audit shell I cannot open. That is the whole of what they have taken.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: What I have is the number. 88-231-C. And there is no procedure in this system for flagging a number out of somebody's head.
